title: custom:wind-card-pro
description: Wind speed, direction and gusts as a tile, a flow tile or a hero, with an animated wind field that rules colour.

entity.description: The wind speed sensor, or a weather entity (wind_speed, wind_bearing and wind_gust_speed attributes)

direction.description: Direction sensor: degrees or a compass point (N, NNE …). Overrides a weather entity's wind_bearing

gust.description: Gust speed sensor. Overrides a weather entity's wind_gust_speed

name.description: The name (default: the sensor's friendly name, or Wind). Template allowed.

secondary.description: Replaces the line under the name (default: speed · direction, or label · from … · gusts …). Template allowed.

rules.description: On the speed (below / above): colour of the particles and the lead, label and tint; first match wins

visual.description: tile only: `flow` makes the whole tile the animated field

lead.description: The round lead: a small animation of the flow style, or the direction arrow (the flow tile always shows the arrow)

height.description: Height of the hero's flow band (px)
